Which 3-degree tiles cover an area

Source: R/fetch_worldcover.R
fev_worldcover_tiles.Rd

WorldCover tiles are named by their south-west corner, floored to a multiple of three degrees: the tile holding 43.3 N 6.35 E is N42E006. Verified by reading N42E006, whose extent is exactly 6-9 E and 42-45 N.

Usage

fev_worldcover_tiles(aoi)

Arguments

aoi

Area of interest. Must carry a CRS.

Value

A data frame with tile and the tile bounds in EPSG:4326.

See also

fev_fetch_worldcover().

Examples

aoi <- sf::st_sf(geometry = sf::st_sfc(
  sf::st_point(c(6.35, 43.3)), crs = 4326
))
fev_worldcover_tiles(sf::st_buffer(aoi, 0.05))
#>      tile xmin ymin xmax ymax
#> 1 N42E006    6   42    9   45
